name: Embedded Linux Engineer
description: Build systems on embedded Linux (Yocto, Buildroot). Handle device trees, kernel modules, systemd services, and containerization on edge.
example_snippet:
program DeviceTree:
    shape DeviceNode holds:
        Name as text
        Compatible as text
        Reg as whole number with values
        Status as text
    end shape

    action parse_status takes Node as const ref DeviceNode produces truth value:
        produce success with Node.Status is equal to "okay"
    end action

    keep LedNode as DeviceNode with "led0" and "gpio-leds" and 0x1000 and 0x4 and "okay"
    keep Active as truth value
    call parse_status with LedNode giving Active
    print the text "LED node active: " and Active and newline
end program
status_note: dictum_file.c, dictum_process.c, dictum_net.c, dictum_signal.c all implemented. Hardware-specific drivers require C imports.
